audit_findings.title: Pending transaction introduces a large senior financing burden absent from owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: $250.0m delayed-draw Senior Credit Facility commitment replacing the earlier $790.0m bridge/backstop package; actual borrowing and interest expense unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: After closing, interest on funded transaction debt reduces equity-level OE because this valuation retains interest expense rather than deducting debt principal in the bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: On January 29, 2026, SpinCo and the Company executed a 364-day bridge loan facility commitment letter with a financial institution, pursuant to which such financial institution committed to provide $ 790 million in aggregate (collectively, the “Bridge Facilities”) to SpinCo and the Company.
audit_findings.explanation: This is not a demonstrated error in the present as-filed valuation because the transaction has not closed and neither the acquired earnings nor its financing has entered the numerator. It is a material post-closing risk: using combined earnings without the actual financing cost would overstate value. The original $790.0m commitment is no longer the best measure because the backstop was terminated and the bridge was replaced by a $250.0m permanent facility.
audit_findings.action: At closing, obtain the funded balance, interest rate, fees, hedges and repayment schedule, then rebuild combined-company OE with actual interest expense and acquired operating results.

audit_findings.title: Closing makes the current numerator and share denominator describe different claims
audit_findings.magnitude: Former SpinCo shareholders are expected to own approximately 40.0%; if 32.260708m pre-Merger fully diluted shares represent 60.0%, the implied combined denominator is approximately 53.768m shares, including approximately 21.507m new shares
audit_findings.mechanism: Closing changes both the OE numerator through consolidation of Performance Technologies and the fully diluted share denominator through stock issuance; financing, liabilities and any special dividend also alter the equity claim.
audit_findings.evidence: In addition, shareholders of the Company immediately prior to the Merger will own approximately 60.0% and former SpinCo shareholders as of the Distribution will own approximately 40.0% of the outstanding shares of Common Stock on a fully diluted basis.
audit_findings.explanation: The current as-filed OE and pre-Merger share count describe the same existing claim, so there is no demonstrated present mismatch. Upon closing, the valuation becomes obsolete. Direction cannot be determined because the acquired OE and assets may add value while dilution, debt, liabilities and integration costs reduce it.
audit_findings.action: Rerun immediately after closing using combined-company OE, actual issued and fully diluted shares, funded debt, assumed liabilities, purchase adjustments, transaction costs and any special dividend.

audit_findings.title: A potentially material uninsured recall claim is not captured in historical OE
audit_findings.mechanism: Any uninsured payment would reduce equity value as a liability or cash outflow; recurring quality costs could also reduce normalized OE.
audit_findings.evidence: If the Company is obligated to indemnify VW for the direct and indirect costs associated with the recall, such costs could be material.
audit_findings.explanation: The 261,257-vehicle recall and lack of expected insurance coverage are demonstrated, but Gentherm has not accepted responsibility and states that its exposure cannot be reasonably estimated. The $13.646m aggregate warranty accrual at June 30, 2026 is not identified as the reserve for this recall, so it cannot quantify the exposure. Seller indemnification may offset only part of any loss. The record therefore supports a real unresolved possibility but cannot establish monetary materiality.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the claim correspondence and cost model, Gentherm's probable allocation of responsibility, the Alfmeier indemnity terms and collectability, and any recall-specific accrual; then deduct the expected net exposure from the bridge or rerun OE if costs are recurring.

audit_findings.title: Deal failure could create a near-one-year-OE cash charge
audit_findings.magnitude: $45.0m conditional fee, equal to 97.2% of the $46.3m OE anchor, 5.4% of the $828m base equity value, or approximately $1.39 per share before tax effects
audit_findings.mechanism: If triggered, the fee is a one-time cash claim against equity and belongs in the equity bridge rather than steady-state OE; additional unaccrued transaction costs would also reduce cash.
audit_findings.evidence: If the Modine Transaction is not consummated because the Merger Agreement is terminated for specified reasons, we may be required to pay Modine a termination fee of $45 million or may be required to reimburse Modine for expenses.
audit_findings.explanation: The fee is large enough to matter, but it remains conditional on specified termination circumstances and is not a demonstrated present liability. Gentherm had already recorded $27.7m of merger and acquisition expense during the first half of 2026, so those incurred costs are real, while the incremental close-or-break costs remain unresolved.
audit_findings.action: Review the termination clauses and current closing status, identify accrued and committed transaction costs and reimbursements, and run separate close and break bridges, including the $45.0m fee only where its triggering conditions apply.

audit_findings.title: The gross cash addback may include cash required to operate the business
audit_findings.magnitude: $213.173m gross cash addback, equal to 25.7% of $828m base equity value or $6.61 per share; $165.6m, or 77.7%, was held by non-U.S. subsidiaries; the subsequent IME acquisition required $34.0m
audit_findings.mechanism: Only distributable excess cash belongs in the equity bridge; minimum operating liquidity, withholding leakage, restricted or committed cash and post-balance-sheet deployment must be excluded or reflected through updated cash and debt.
audit_findings.evidence: Our cash requirements consist principally of working capital, capital expenditures, research and development, operating lease payments, income tax payments and general corporate purposes.
audit_findings.explanation: It is demonstrated that the bridge adds all June 30 cash, but the record does not demonstrate that all of it is excess. The company reports ongoing working-capital and operating requirements, substantial foreign-held cash and a $34.0m acquisition completed one day after the balance-sheet date using cash and revolver borrowings. Although the filing says there were no significant current distribution restrictions, the gross pool is large enough that a reasonable non-excess allocation could materially alter per-share value.
audit_findings.action: Prepare a jurisdiction-level cash schedule, quantify minimum operating liquidity, restrictions and withholding taxes, identify Modine and other committed uses, and update cash and debt for the $34.0m IME acquisition and subsequent activity; rerun the bridge using only verified excess cash.
